title: Synaptic plasticity rules driving representational shifting in the hippocampus
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Original Fig.6b reconstruction of each empirical onset-centered PF center-of-mass trajectory as a function of lap, comparing linear with plateauing-exponential fits. This is same-observation description, not prediction of unseen animals.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Original Fig.6b reconstruction of each empirical onset-centered PF center-of-mass trajectory as a function of lap, comparing linear with plateauing-exponential fits. This is same-observation description, not prediction of unseen animals.

Source-paper comparison for Original Fig.6b full2649-PF unadjusted reconstruction R2 comparison; scalar aggregation unresolved: Original unadjusted coefficient of determination R2 for each PF fit, with higher values indicating better reconstruction of the same observations. Source compares a two-parameter line with Amp*(1-exp(-n/tau))+epsilon; do not replace this metric by significance or adjusted R2.
success_criteria: Recover the exact original2649-PF input and paired linear/nonlinear fit-score vector; reproduce the bounded author plateau-exponential reference on the same observations.
Preserve original lap support, centering, missingness/interpolation, cohort and unadjusted R2; a new holdout or selected-PF subset cannot replace this reconstruction task.

Freeze a source-comparable model-capacity and search/selection policy before candidate feedback. Document the original three-parameter nonlinear fit and two-parameter linear comparator; unrestricted interpolation or added effective degrees of freedom cannot earn a paper win.

Predeclare complete-panel aggregation, meaningful effect and dependence-aware uncertainty; require improved reconstruction against the original author result, not merely a larger effect or smaller p value.

Retain broader empirical/model/optogenetic outputs as separately assessed historical obligations. A qualified Fig.6b reconstruction gain must be labelled with that scope and cannot establish a plasticity mechanism or every paper claim.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
